review.assessment: The change replaces a stub with a complete implementation of `is_valid_ipv4`. It splits the input on '.', verifies exactly four octets exist, checks that each contains only ASCII digits without leading zeros (except '0' itself), and ensures each parses to ≤255. This correctly enforces canonical dotted-quad format and rejects all common invalid inputs: empty strings, trailing/leading dots, extra dots, whitespace, out-of-range numbers, non-digits, and leading zeros.
